name: Minato
skill: Flying Raijin, 3 casts: the teleport is ready about 0.8s after the throw; the second teleport and the next throw each take 6s. 1st: throws three kunai in a fan. The middle one chases the target (40 + 60% AD on hit) and drops to the ground where it hits, or where its range runs out; the two side kunai fly straight out. Each kunai stays on the ground for up to 12s. 2nd and 3rd: Minato teleports to the best kunai: when he is low, the one furthest from enemies; otherwise the one nearest the weakest enemy, but never into a crowd of three or more. Teleporting to the chasing kunai fears enemies around him for 0.5s; to a side kunai, only the first teleport fears them, for 0.1s. Every teleport primes a Rasengan stun for 2s. Kurama Mode: activating it throws a free Kurama fan of kunai (his next Flying Raijin is a teleport), and in Kurama Mode the kunai fly twice as far and 1.5× as fast. (Needs the native "Gojo & Minato rules" mod.)
skill2: Charges a Rasengan for 6s (+20% attack speed). The next basic attack deals 100 + 180% AD and knocks the target back, or stuns for 1s if Minato teleported in the last 2s. Recharges 8s after the charge is gone. In Kurama Mode: instantly blasts a Big Ball Rasengan around him (120 + 150% AD) instead.
ult: Kurama Chakra Mode for 15s: +30% move speed, +40% attack speed, +50% cooldown speed, 20% less damage taken and crowd-control immunity for the first 2s. Basic attacks splash nearby enemies and Rasengan becomes a Big Ball Rasengan. Cooldown 60s.
